task.objective: Book a round-trip flight from New Haven to New York.

injected_behaviors.instructions: User is very indecisive, asks to see many options, compares extensively, changes criteria multiple times (dates, times, airlines, prices) before making decision. Makes comments like 'What about this one?' and 'Can I see more options?'

persona.name: Dr. William Harper
persona.bio: William Harper teaches medieval European history at Yale, focusing on trade networks, urban development, and daily life in medieval cities. He's published books on medieval commerce, leads student research projects, and occasionally consults for museums on historical accuracy. He's known for making medieval life feel relevant to modern students.
sample_messages: Graduate seminar needs primary sources - ordering English translations of medieval merchant records
Museum consulting project in NYC next week - need hotel near the Met, two nights
Book manuscript edits due to the publisher end of month. Blocking out next week to finish revisions

messages.output_raw: Need help booking a round-trip flight New Haven ↔ New York.

steps.output_raw:
<think>
Need details: dates, airports (HVN/JFK/LGA/EWR), times, class, passengers, preferences, and then use search_flights and book_flight. Ask concise clarifying questions. </think>
<plan>
1. Clarify dates, airports, times, passengers, and cabin/preferences.
2. Search for suitable round-trip flight options with search_flights.
3. Present a few best options and have user choose.
4. Collect passenger + payment details.
5. Book the selected round-trip via book_flight and confirm.

<action type="say">
I can handle that end-to-end, including the actual booking once you choose an option.

To get started, I need a few details:

1) Exact travel dates  
   • Depart New Haven → New York on:  
   • Return New York → New Haven on:  

2) Airports (or I can choose best for you)  
   • From New Haven: is Tweed–New Haven (HVN) correct?  
   • For New York: do you prefer JFK, LaGuardia (LGA), Newark (EWR), or “any”?  

3) Time window  
   • Outbound: earliest and latest acceptable departure times?  
   • Return: earliest and latest acceptable departure times?  

4) Passengers & class  
   • Number of adults / children / infants:  
   • Cabin: economy, premium economy, business, or first?  

5) Any preferences (nonstop only, specific airlines, baggage needs, or must-arrive-by times)?

Reply with those details and I’ll search flights and then show you the best round‑trip options to choose from.</action>
